title: Minneapolis Mill City Self Guided Audio Walking Tour
includes: Smartphone guided walking tour on our walking tour app
Hands free, location aware, plays as you walk
Explore the city's story at your own pace
Go at your own pace, anytime, the tour never expires.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Our tour will take you from Peavey Plaza, the city’s “living room”, through the bustling downtown to the riverfront, ending at the Mill City Museum, built right into the ruins of the world’s once-largest flour mill. Go at your own pace, anytime. The tour plays as you walk and is hands free. It never expires! This is perfect for those looking for a private experience, flexibility and at an affordable price point.
